trigger: The first notebook execution stopped before target construction because 11 backward calendar sessions lacked at least one of the 33 firm-open headline aggregates.

return_blind_diagnostic.method: Count distinct company symbols per mapped firm-open session in the validated paired-scorer aggregate cache; do not inspect strategy returns or outcome summaries.

frozen_resolution.calendar: Retain every common 33-company LSEG price session between the first and last mapped session.
frozen_resolution.complete_session: A session is complete only when both scorer panels contain all companies in the current replay universe; a Gemma strongest-event tie-abstention is a valid observed score, not missing coverage.
frozen_resolution.incomplete_session_action: Force the portfolio target to cash for that session and close any prior position through the unchanged drift-aware ledger. Do not rank the incomplete FinBERT cross-section, impute a score, carry a stale rank, or skip across the session.
frozen_resolution.signal_population_gate: Count only complete sessions toward the frozen 120-session minimum. Active-session and per-half minima are evaluated on the complete-session schedule.
frozen_resolution.circular_shift: Shift the Gemma activity/count schedule only among complete sessions; incomplete sessions remain fixed cash. FinBERT ranks remain on their original complete sessions.
frozen_resolution.random_name_null: Use only active complete sessions and preserve their counts, cap, and leg exposure.
frozen_resolution.leave_out_replays: Recompute completeness for the reduced universe from the original observed firm-open flags, then rebuild activity and ranks; never treat a synthetically completed grid row as observed.
